title: If you're a button, you have one job
summary: An article exploring the fundamental design principle that buttons should have a single, clear purpose in user interfaces. The piece discusses how clear button design improves user experience by reducing cognitive load and preventing user confusion about what actions will occur.
problem_solved: Addresses the common UI design problem of buttons with ambiguous or multiple purposes that confuse users.
why_valuable: Provides actionable design guidance that can improve interface clarity and user satisfaction across web and application development projects.
